## P-2026-08-22-1: per-phase memory ceiling on agent subprocesses
Evidence: text2cad added RLIMIT_AS per phase after two OOM kills took the whole box (sibling repo, ops notes).
Change: harness/agents.py — set resource.setrlimit(RLIMIT_AS) in a preexec_fn for the claude subprocess, cap from a constant.
Tier: CODE
Cost of not doing it: one runaway phase can OOM the only machine Bob runs on, silencing every loop at once.
